translation_notes: outer subjects(RDFS.domain, cls) is a single-motif m{ ?prop rdfs:domain {cls} }; the isinstance(prop, URIRef) filter is kept verbatim since a plain m{ } can bind a blank node too.

range/label/comment are three g.value() lookups on the same prop, each independently guarded (config.include_labels, config.include_descriptions) and each tolerant of absence -- per prior trav_navigation findings, folding them into one multi-pattern m{ } would turn the missing-value case into a dropped row instead of a None, so each stays its own m{ }.first().
context shim (shacl_context.py) reconstructs PropertyConstraint, ShaclConfig and DomainRangeConverter._is_datatype/XSD_DATATYPES from the upstream source at the pinned commit.
